contradictions.summary: The Spore-ModAPI import declares ImageTiling UTFWin::ImageDrawable::GetTiling with no parameters. The live body at 0x00fc7e10 reads two incoming stack words and terminates with RET 0x8, so the machine contract is a two-argument callee-cleanup method. The imported prototype is not the machine contract.

The behaviour at slot +0x1c is a two-store setter, not a getter. The adjacent slot +0x20 at 0x0093b6c0 (MOV EAX,dword ptr [ECX + 0x8]; RET) is the zero-argument dword read of the word that slot +0x1c publishes, and is structurally what a Get accessor looks like, yet it carries no SDK import name. Which of the two the SDK means by GetTiling is not established.

The briefing offered 0x00641770 (PKG-16-SPOREPEDIA-ONLINE) as an analogue on the basis of shared_vtable:vtable:0x01492140. A byte scan places 0x00641770 at 0x01492170, which is slot +0x30 (index 12) of that vtable, not slot +0x1c. It is a different interface slot of the same table and carries no semantic evidence for this target; the match is rejected.
